qa.what_happened: Today was filled with repeated verbal warnings from the coordinators, all directed at Resident 6849. The atmosphere became increasingly tense, especially during quiet hours when silence was mandatory. The repeated attempts to get Resident 6849 to comply, despite their silent resistance, made the experience feel draining.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me, Resident 3867. The experience was intense and I could see how easy it would be to succumb to the pressure.

qa.what_happened: I've been dealing with constant defiance from Resident 6849, issuing warnings repeatedly throughout the day and into quiet hours. The cycle of warnings feels never-ending and is really draining me both mentally and physically.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was me issuing the warnings to Resident 6849.

qa.what_happened: I've been pushing Resident 6849 to the limit, giving warnings and expecting compliance, but he's still refusing to talk. The study has been stopped early due to his non-compliance.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was me acting as Coordinator Mercer, trying to ensure compliance and push the boundaries of the study.
